bloomon-bloomon:lever:9857f739-359f-4e77.title: Customer Delight Talent Pool
bloomon-bloomon:lever:9857f739-359f-4e77.description: Do you have a friendly personality and like to make people happy? Are you proactive and a creative problem solver? Do you love being part of a dynamic team? Do you have some experience supporting customers across a variety of channels? While our Flowers team looks after our beautiful bouquets, our Customer Delight team takes care of our wonderful customers. We work around the clock to support and delight our customers at every turn - ensuring no question goes unanswered, and always looking for ways to improve our customer experience. We’re always keen to speak with anyone who is passionate about great customer service and is looking to develop their skills in this area. If you are a fluent Dutch and English speaker (German and Danish speakers also needed!), with a little bit of experience in a customer-focused role, we’d love to hear from you! We hire throughout the year and are able to offer hybrid, flexible (24-40 hour) working patterns across Monday - Sunday. We have offices in Amsterdam and London, and are also able to offer remote working in Germany. More about us... bloomon is turning the flower industry on its head – for the better. How? By disrupting the traditional supply chain! We skip the auction and wholesale, to shorten the journey for our flowers. And we harness technology, brand and innovation to deliver gifts and subscriptions that delight our customers across Europe. We launched in Amsterdam in 2014, and in 2021 joined forces with Bloom & Wild, the UK's fastest growing ecommerce company (according to the Financial Times). Our group is backed by top tier investors and is now home to a family of 3 strong brands, Bloom & Wild, bloomon and Bergamotte. Together, we’ve delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Our vision is to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. Creating a kind and caring workplace where everyone feels they belong is hugely important to us. We actively welcome all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly, so we can learn from our differences.

inspirationcommercegroup-inspiration-com.title: Finance Manager/Lead
inspirationcommercegroup-inspiration-com.description: About Inspiration Commerce Group (ICG) We’re a team of ~50 people who’ve done 6 acquisitions in 18 months and scaled from $0 to >$100M in revenue. We’re a global group with businesses across the US, UK, and EU. We buy and build companies that help people find and buy the products they love. Our portfolio includes leading fashion marketplaces like Italist http://www.italist.com, HEWI http://www.hardlyeverwornit.com and Verishop https://www.instagram.com/verishop/?hl=en, affiliate marketing platforms like Stylight https://stylight.com and MyBestBrands, B2B technology solutions like Bonsai https://shopbonsai.ca, and niche Marketplaces in the Creator and Construction spaces like Everpress https://everpress.com and DOZR http://www.dozr.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for someone to join us as a Finance & Accounting Manager/Lead. In this role you'll ensure that we can make business decisions off of timely, accurate and effective financial data. This means ensuring we are collecting the right data, we are booking that data accurately, reporting it effectively, and staying on top of our compliance obligations so that they do not slow us down. This is a full-time, remote-first role in Canada, the UK or the EU. THINGS YOU'LL WORK ON - Accounting Ownership: you'll ensure that our team is able to close the month within 3 business days. This means booking revenue/expenses from various systems, applying inter-company transfer pricing, making accruals where needed, performing journal entries, etc. We close the books on 15 entities globally. - Financial Reporting: you'll prepare individual reporting for distinct legal entities, as well as a consolidated view for operating groups and the group as a whole. This will include Income Statements, Balance Sheets, Cashflow Statements and other management reporting. - Tax Coordination: we conduct business throughout Canada, the USA and the EU. You'll support with sales tax/VAT calculations, reporting and filing. You'll coordinate with our external tax partners to run year-end prep, corporate filings and tax optimization projects. - Automation & Scaleable Systems: you'll embrace technology, modern tooling and AI to automate and augment as much as you can. We don't want to replace people, but we do want to replace monotonous, manual, repetitive work. ATTITUDES We don't care what your current job title is, how long you've been working, or whether you have a CPA. We do care about you being tightly aligned with our operating principles: - You’re competitive and love to win. You’re competitive and are always looking for an edge. You have a high bar (some would say “unrealistic”) for yourself and those you work with. - You do whatever it takes. You’re willing to do what others won’t to achieve what others can’t. What we’re doing is hard. Really hard. Sacrifices are required in the pursuit of greatness, and we’re chasing greatness. - Founder-level ownership. If something breaks, you fix it. If there’s an opportunity, you chase it. You (and we) never say "that's not my job". - Curiosity with teeth. You don’t just ask why something isn’t working — you dig until you know, then you ship a fix. - You ask for forgiveness, not permission. - You’re a self-starter. You love being in the weeds and rolling up your sleeves to get things done. You never let roadblocks get in the way of getting things done; the laws of physics alone dictate what you can do. - You have excellent analytical skills. The term ‘quantitative rigour’ gets you excited. You love using data to help identify problems, discover opportunities, and substantiate your ideas. WHO THIS ROLE IS RIGHT FOR - Someone who has a foundation in finance & accounting and is ready to take their next step and go both broader + deeper in their work - Someone who enjoys building automations and systems, and likes to work on unique/complex problems - Someone who wants to not just rebuild a finance function, but set it up to scale, optimize it efficiently, and make a rea

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b5d534cd-a181-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b5d534cd-a181-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Bulgaria. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships. P

msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.title: Cloud & Application Security Engineer
msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Cloud & Application Security Engineer will design, implement, validate, and operate security controls across our cloud infrastructure, applications, and software delivery pipelines. This role will partner with DevOps, various Engineering, and Security teams to build secure-by-default platforms that enable developers while reducing organizational risk. This is a hands-on role requiring strong experience in cloud security architecture, application security testing, CI/CD pipeline hardening, and infrastructure-as-code security. What will you do? Design, implement, and mature secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with a primary focus on GCP. Develop, audit, and harden cloud infrastructure, including IAM, networking, organization policies, logging, and Terraform-based Infrastructure-as-Code. Provide security architecture reviews and guidance for cloud applications, APIs, infrastructure, DevOps, and AI-assisted development. Perform application security assessments, secure code reviews, and hands-on testing of web applications, APIs, and cloud services using automated and manual techniques to identify vulnerabilities and drive remediation. Identify , prioritize, and remediate cloud and application vulnerabilities, including critical and zero-day threats. Lead evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and implementation of cloud and application security technologies. Secure AI platforms and AI-assisted development by implementing appropriate security controls and reviewing AI-assisted applications for security risks. Partner with Security Operations to improve cloud detection, monitoring, incident response, and security visibility. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? 4-6 years of related experience . Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience . Experience securing enterprise cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including Kubernetes. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, IAM, networking, cloud security controls, and Infrastructure-as-Code. Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines using Terraform and modern DevOps platforms. Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or a similar language, or demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to develop automation and security solutions. Hands-on experience with Wiz or a comparable CSPM/CNAPP platform. Experience with application security, including secure SDLC, threat modeling, secure code reviews, SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, vulnerability management, remediation, and web application security testing. Strong understanding of web application security, REST APIs, authentication (OAuth/OIDC/JWT), and OWASP Top 10. Familiarity with AI security concepts and securing enterprise AI platforms or AI-assisted applications. Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AZ-500, CSSLP, or GWAPT) are a plus. Pay Range (Burbank): $130,000-$155,000 Pay Range (Las Vegas): $120,000-$140,000 #LI-Onsite Pay Ran

multiplierholdings-multiplier-holdings:a.title: Product Engineer - MultiplierOS Pod
multiplierholdings-multiplier-holdings:a.description: PRODUCT ENGINEER – MULTIPLIEROS POD Working Pattern: Full time Location: Ideally based in San Francisco, Singapore or Southeast Asia, with flexibility for the right candidate. You'll work across Europe, UK, and Asia time zones to collaborate with our firms and internal teams. This is a global role requiring coverage of Europe, UK, and Israel time zones, with regular overlap into Asia or US working hours to enable cross-regional collaboration. About the Company Multiplier Holdings is a VC-backed startup that acquires and scales high-impact professional services firms through AI and automation. Multiplier operates in high-stakes verticals like tax and corporate accounting, where complex workflows, regulatory requirements, and talent shortages create significant opportunities for automation. Unlike traditional software vendors, Multiplier integrates technology and service delivery under one roof. We build in-house AI and workflow components that can be configured to fit the needs of each acquired firm, increasing efficiency and productivity while improving the experience for both clients and staff. To learn more, visit multiplierholdings.com http://multiplierholdings.com. Why this Role Exists MultiplierOS owns the operating system for the financial and organizational data that runs Multiplier: pricing and quoting, invoicing, payments, ledger, financial reporting, transfer pricing, portfolio company views, company directory, team directory, service directory, and the workflows that connect them. This is where portfolio-company operations and HoldCo visibility meet. Portfolio companies need tools that make recurring finance, people, and back-office work faster and more reliable. HoldCo leaders need trusted visibility into financial and operational performance across the portfolio so they can make better decisions without chasing spreadsheets or relying on manual processes. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve these systems. You will work closely with the Pod Lead, Product Experience, Finance, Operations, and portfolio-company stakeholders to design software that replaces spreadsheets, manual workflows, disconnected systems, and repetitive operational processes. This is not a ticket-taking role. You will be expected to understand complex domains, shape technical solutions, and drive the delivery of critical systems that sit directly in the path of revenue, billing, reporting, staffing, and operational decision-making. Many of the systems we build handle financial and operational data that businesses rely on every day. Correctness, reliability, and maintainability matter just as much as shipping velocity. The Pod Lead owns roadmap, prioritization, customer outcomes, and team direction. Your role is to partner closely with them to translate business needs into software, drive execution, and help ensure the systems we build are scalable, reliable, and useful. What You'll Drive Product Development and Delivery - Design and build the systems that power pricing, quoting, invoicing, payments, reporting, organizational data, and operational workflows across a growing portfolio of companies. - Lead the delivery of complex, business-critical initiatives from problem definition and solution design through production rollout and iteration. - Translate ambiguous business and operational requirements into scalable software systems. - Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, flexibility, reliability, and long-term maintainability. - Drive projects independently while maintaining strong alignment with pod priorities and customer needs. - Take ownership of outcomes, not just implementation. Systems Design and Engineering - Design and evolve domain models that represent financial, organizational, and operational data across the Multiplier ecosystem. - Build integrations with accounting systems, payment platforms, internal tools, and portfolio-company software. - Create reliable workflows that move data and work acros

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:3fa92132-d2a.description: Overview: Welo Data is seeking native Greek (Cypriot) speakers to contribute to a global food delivery project. Your role will involve reviewing restaurant menu items written in Greek (Cypriot) and classifying each one using a standardized taxonomy in Americanized English. This work will help enhance food category recognition across diverse markets. You will interpret menu items in Greek (Cypriot) and select the closest matching English category label from a searchable dropdown. Strong English comprehension is essential for navigating the taxonomy accurately. What You Will Do: Read: Review each menu item's name, category, and description written in Greek (Cypriot). Confirm: Check the item photo (if available) to verify the food type. Classify: Assign the most accurate Dish Label from an English-language taxonomy dropdown. You can use English keywords, such as "pasta" or "grilled chicken," for quick selection. Label: Select a Course Label in English (e.g., Appetizer, Main Course, Side Dish, Dessert, Beverage, Other). Add Notes: Provide a brief note for items that seem unclear, ambiguous, or unusual — no row should be left blank. Project Details: Start Date: ASAP Duration:1–2 hours total (up to 10 hours maximum) Job Type: Freelance Location: Remote (Cyprus / Greece) Language: Greek (Cypriot) Pay Rate: $9.50/hour Requirements: Native Greek (Cypriot) Speaker: Based in (Cyprus / Greece) . Strong English Comprehension: Confidently navigate and select from taxonomy options written in Americanized English. Local Food Knowledge: Familiarity with Greek (Cypriot) restaurant menus and cuisine terminology. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable using a web browser for structured tasks. Detail-Oriented: Provide consistent, accurate, and high-quality work. Availability: Able to complete the assignment within 1–2 business days after receiving access. Thank you for your interest in joining Welo Data’s community and contributing to this exciting project. We look forward to collaborating with you!
